PDF Solutions CONNECT, the Premier Event for Semiconductor Analytics and AI, October 15 and 16 in San Franciscoby Daniel Nenni on 09-27-2026 at 12:00 pm

Categories: EDA, PDF Solutions

Key takeaways ▼

On October 15 and 16, 2026, in San Francisco, PDF Solutions will hold PDF Solutions CONNECT, the premier event for Semiconductor Analytics and AI. This event starts at the end of SEMICON WEST 2026 in a location in close proximity to the Moscone Center. It is a great opportunity for leading semiconductor and equipment companies attending SEMICON WEST to come and hear from their industry peers as they explain their real-world experiences using PDF solutions.
Executives from Qualcomm and STMicroelectronics will describe their projects deploying advanced test solutions. Samsung’s Senior Director of Metrology and Inspection will speak about their adoption of PDF Solutions DirectScan technology to ramp up their leading-edge chips. Intel Principal Engineer Syed Baquar will explain how Intel is transforming its manufacturing data infrastructure and moving to AI driven analytics with PDF Solutions. Dr Suresh Venkatesan, CEO of POET Technologies, will present on how to manage operational challenges in a fast-growing innovative company.
On Thursday evening, Teradyne CEO Greg Smith, IMEC CEO Patrick Vandenameele, Siemens EDA EVP Ankur Gupta will join PDF Solutions CEO John Kibarian in panel discussion led by Emily Chang from Bloomberg Technologies. This promises to be a lively conversation! And on Friday, October 16, Dr Jonathan Koomey will deliver a keynote titled “Thinking about technology futures: A look at computing energy use.”
September 9 was a big day for PDF. That’s when we released a detailed announcement introducing Exensio® Aurora, a new highly scalable Exensio analytics architecture, purpose-built to handle semiconductor manufacturing data at petabyte scale and to securely deploy agentic AI across manufacturing operations and the supply chain. PDF Solutions CONNECT will provide a firsthand opportunity to look at Exensio Aurora, hear semiconductor leaders share real-world results, and see live demos of new capabilities in LLM-driven analytics, advanced big data processing, and next-generation user experiences.
At this event, PDF Solutions will also present the latest solutions specifically targeted to manufacturing equipment companies. We will provide an in-depth discussion of Cimetrix® Equipment Control Foundation, and some of the newer AI solutions for equipment optimization. Additionally, we will cover the latest developments for secureWISE, PDF Solutions global platform for semiconductor manufacturing equipment secure remote connectivity and control.
Christophe Begue, VP of Corporate Strategic Marketing, PDF Solutions.
Details: PDF Solutions CONNECT 2026
October 15–16 at The Westin St. Francis on Union Square in San Francisco.
